question: How do you hire, onboard, and retain top-quartile SDRs when the role has historically 35-40% annual churn?
answer:
## Direct Top-quartile SDR shops fix churn via **clear AE promotion path, activity metrics transparency, peer coaching culture, and $55-65k compensation**. ## Detail ### Why SDR Churn Hits 35-40% **Root causes** (not pay alone): - **Unclear promotion criteria**: Reps hit quota but don't know when they'll be promoted; AE scarcity amplifies frustration - **Activity-only culture**: Managed on **dials/emails/calls**, not **qual quality** or **business acumen**; feels transactional - **No career narrative**: "SDR" feels like prison, not launchpad; peer coaching is minimal - **Isolation burden**: Rep owns **100% of rejection**, 0% of deal outcome; lacks connection to closed pipeline - **Limited comp growth**: Salary **$40-50k** year 1, **$45-52k** year 2 (minimal bump); frustration vs. AE earning **$100-150k** ### Hire: Screening for Coachability **Typical mistake**: Hire top 10% on natural charisma/sales background. **Reality**: Top-quartile SDRs are **coachable, process-oriented, curious**, not necessarily extroverted. **Screening framework**: | Trait | How to Test | Interview Question | |-------|---|---| | Coachability | Past feedback loops | "Tell me a time you got critical feedback. What did you do?" (Listen: specific action, not defensiveness) | | Process discipline | Attention to detail | Audit their email/slides sent pre-interview (grammar, structure). Bad = bad SDR. | | Rejection resilience | Emotional regulation | "What % of your outreach typically converts? How do you stay motivated on rejections?" (Listen: <3% is realistic; growth mindset over false confidence) | | Intellectual curiosity | Deep listening | Ask about their company's sales motion. Do they ask **how** your product fits, or just nod? | | Persistence without aggression | Role-play response | "A prospect says 'not interested.' Your response?" (Want: soft persistence + pivot, not hard close) | **Pavilion benchmark**: **Top 25% retention cohorts** hired for **"coachability"** show **45-50% Year 1 retention** vs. **natural sales reps** at **30-35%**. ### Onboard: Structured 90-Day Ramp **Week 1-4: Foundations (50% productivity)** - Daily 30-min coaching calls with SDR manager (not AE) - **MEDDPICC fundamentals**: Teach qualification, not just pitch - Shadowing: 5 AE calls/week (listen-only, annotate discovery questions) - **First 100 dials**: Pre-qualified warm list (not cold; 20%+ reply target to build confidence) **Week 5-8: Execution (75% productivity)** - Transition to **assigned list segment** (vertical, company size, or use case) - **Weekly 1:1 coaching** (vs. daily); shift from "how do I dial" to "why didn't that land" - Peer pairing: 2x/week with **top-quartile peer** SDR (model behavior, introduce to playbook) - **Win analysis**: Review 2-3 closed deals per week with AE; map their research to discovery questions **Week 9-12: Mastery (90%+ productivity)** - Solo activity; still 1:1/week coaching focused on **qual consistency** - **Promotion readiness assessment**: Track qual rep creation, deal velocity, not just dials - Introduce to peer coaching (junior SDR shadows them 1x/week) ### Retention: Transparent Promotion & Comp Growth **Clear AE Promotion Criteria** (Publish, track monthly) - **Stage 1 (Months 3-6)**: 40+ qual calls/month + **>30% AE handoff qual rate** + **<5 dud opps/month** (false positives) - **Stage 2 (Months 7-12)**: 60+ qual opps/month + **>35% close rate on SDR-sourced deals** + **peer coaching credibility** (1+ junior rep improved) - **Stage 3 (Months 13+)**: Demonstrate **AE-ready skills**: multi-stakeholder qualification, ROI discovery, champion mapping **Promotion timeline**: Month 12-14 for **top 25%** of cohort (creates scarcity, incentivizes excellence). Month 18-20 for **median performers**. **Don't artificially gate SDR → AE tier** to 1 per year; remove artificial scarcity by promoting **top quartile early**. **Compensation Growth** - Year 1 base: **$45-50k** + **$8-15k bonus** (quota: **40 qual opps/month** = **120/quarter**) - Year 2 promotion: **$60-70k base** (AE ramp) or **$52-58k base** (stay-as-SDR track) - **Stay-as-SDR track**: For top performers who prefer expertise over management. Base **$52-58k**, bonus **$12-20k**, title **"SDR Manager" or "Sales Development Lead"** (mentoring, playbook development). Offers **80-90% of AE comp**, removes promotion pressure. ### Culture: Transparency + Peer Coaching **Activity transparency** - **Weekly dashboard**: Each SDR sees team's **dial count, reply rate, qual rate, deal sourced % (pipeline $)** - **Why**: Kills politics; rep knows exactly where they rank - **Removes subjectivity**: Manager can't arbitrarily block promotion if data says "ready" **Peer coaching structure** - **Top quartile SDRs mentor 1 junior** (2 hours/week) - **Bonus incentive**: **+$2-3k annual** to mentors whose mentees hit Stage 1 promotion criteria - **Rotational**: Every 6 months, pair new junior with different mentor (spreads knowledge, prevents bottleneck) **Deal attribution + team wins** - **Monthly meeting**: SDR team watches **2-3 closed deals** sourced by SDRs. AE + SDR talk about **discovery moments**. - **Why**: Shifts narrative from "I made X dials" to "I contributed to $500k in pipeline." Gamification goes meta-level. ### Retention Metrics to Track | Metric | Baseline | Target | How to Hit | |--------|---|---|---| | Month 3 retention | 60-70% | 80-85% | Structured ramp + clear promotion | | Month 12 retention | 55-65% | 75%+ | AE promotion for top 25% by month 12 | | Year 2 retention | 50-60% | 65-70% | Stay-as-SDR/Lead track for 30%, promote 25-30% to AE | | Top quartile retention | Varies | 80%+ | Comp growth to $55-65k + clear path | ```mermaid flowchart LR A["New SDR Hire

Cost of program: **~$15k/year** (meeting facilitation + bonus pools). ROI: **1 less mid-year replacement hire per 2-3 hires** (**$30-40k savings in onboard/ramp loss**).
